final_discussion_questions.text: Must CLI migration dry-run be strictly zero-write across session and media storage?
Should sidecar cleanup and cross-owner retained references be guaranteed by one retention contract?
Which external absolute legacy attachment paths remain supported and with which live authority?
Should model-bound image count/bytes have provider-specific admission budgets beyond upload caps?
Is audio max duration advisory or enforceable server admission?
What limits must PDF decoding enforce before full stream materialization, and which parser layer owns them?
